scope: Manuscript-phase same-agent review: two mathematical reading passes, exact-source application checks, and targeted computational replay. No unresolved finding in the final revised arguments; this is not outside acceptance, formal verification, or established priority. Frozen deadline classifications are preserved.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the parameter-free formula, primitive quotient direction, centralizer-product condition, and Heisenberg truth set. Current Conte-Petschick question and existential restriction reread.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the parameter-free primitive-centralizer formula and both directions of the determinant and residual-finiteness argument.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the code intersection inequality, every-subgroup estimate, faithful action after the central quotient, and the free-product step. The exponential supremum and failure at the endpoint are uniform in the required variables.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the simplex intersection bound, normal Sylow action kernel, disjoint-weight commutators, uniform bound, and endpoint free-product example.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the quaternion subgroup, cyclic action, degree-eight induction and index-eight monomial obstruction. Kida Conjecture 1.3 and Example 5.5 reread; the example alone does not establish this counterexample.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the quaternion rotation, four weights, degree-eight induction, and index-eight subgroup obstruction.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the variety identities, integral abelianization, central endomorphism, exact pointwise fixing, and rank-one case. Nonperiodic does not impose torsion-free relatively free groups.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the primitive functional, central power endomorphism, exact pointwise fixing, proper image, and nonperiodic-variety scope.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked scalar and determinant-minus-one branches in the matrix lemma, cyclic-vector centralizer argument, and fixed-degree residual obstruction. Preserved the torsion-free lift diag(2i,2).
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the torsion-free semidirect product, centralizer quotient, scalar q-squared-minus-one obstruction, and common representation kernel.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked characteristic-five traces, missing limit point, exact fiber intersection for every power, and the field/reducibility qualifications. Only part (a) is counted.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the trace-one degeneration, distinct transcendental fibers and powers, and the allowed reducibility of the variety.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked every finite coefficient set via a denominator chosen after T, amalgam normal form, isolatedness versus unique roots, and the nonabelian specialization variant. Finitely generated coefficient groups are not asserted.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread finite coefficient reduction, torsion-free amalgam, nonzero root commutator, isolated radical, and the nonabelian variant.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the smaller central product, normal subgroup classification, maps into all quotients, and finite Horn transfer. Read Shakhova original p.239 for the domain-outside-target convention. Larger restricted variant remains a referenced supplementary result.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread all three quotient covers and kernel maps, distinct quotient orders, and the explicit convention permitting a domain outside the quasivariety.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked torsion-freeness, finite abelianization, embeddings above every proper holonomy subspace, explicit finite presentation, and the bounded-variable contradiction. No unsupported residual characterization is used.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the parity construction, torsion-free Bieberbach group, absence of Klein-bottle maps, proper holonomy subspaces, and finite-presentation quasiidentity.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked tensor balancing, both injective endpoint maps, finite-forest leaf argument, simultaneous HNN construction and countable-stage homogeneity. The coefficient ring remains fixed.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the HNN tree module, injectivity by the leaf argument, and countable extension of all finitely generated partial maps.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked actual semidirect construction, derivation signs, kernel action, all possible section lifts and ordered elimination. Read Bergman section 1 and Sakarovitch Theorems 21-22 for the division-ring input.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the ordered-division-ring input, nested semidirect product and cocycle, and four commutation equations giving a contradiction.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked formation closure and internal joins. The noncompactness witness and pentagon concern chosen intersection-closed families, not the full lattice of formations.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread internal joins, the finite-prime nonalgebraicity example, the N5 pentagon, and empty-intersection conventions.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the centerless semidirect product, all automorphisms, normalizing permutation and order-four quotient element. Tsang Theorem 4.5 and exceptions reread.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread all automorphisms, the explicit holomorph normalizer map and composition, and its nontranslation square.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked both characteristic-two and characteristic-zero constructions, perfectness via reduction, infinitude, and centralizers. Finite images are controls and need not themselves have the centralizer property.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread characteristic-two centralizers, the A5 quotient generators, and the 2-adic trace-zero and pro-2 arguments.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked digit-reversal coset intervals, prime-factor boxes and finite-fiber chain encoding. Dimension bound is uniform in the finite family of subgroups.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread reverse base-p digit intervals, primary-product boxes, finite-index fibers, and the stated number of chains.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked affine charts, fixed Cartier divisor, invariant ring and its singular point. Proper stabilizers, rather than just the full fixed locus, explain the failure.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread line-bundle charts, the fixed Cartier divisor, the invariant-ring equation, and singularity with proper stabilizer.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked finite automorphism-orbit use in root extraction, eigenvalue conjugate bounds, finite integral trace set, nilpotent trace ideal, and the explicit index bound.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread bounded-degree root extraction, integrality, the finite root-of-unity set, nilpotent trace ideal, Nakayama step, and finite-index trace cosets.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the order-twelve rational lifts and quaternion order, reduction M2(F2), absence of idempotent lifts, and the explicit C2 extension. The disagreement with prior work is limited to the specified preprint version pending publication comparison.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the rational F2-simple lifting construction, quaternion division order, reduction to matrices, and the missing idempotent. The Ext conflict remains explicitly restricted to arXiv v2.

entries.first_pass_notes: Read the full retained proof; checked rational descent, faithful block multiplicities, the cone relation and incompatible extreme-ray refinements. Primary decomposition matrix and table metadata reread; exact Galois and Frobenius assignments remain for final data review.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread projective lifting and descent, the four rays and multiplicity 168. Fresh GAP input check verified all Frobenius pairs, ordinary Galois orbits, five decomposition rows and projective dimensions; no fresh full MeatAxe reconstruction claimed.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked nonempty-open convention, finite-support ultrafilter neighborhoods, dense size-color classes and the support-block argument excluding discrete selectivity.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the ultrafilter topology, dense degree partition, and separated-subsequence obstruction for maximal supports.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the free-product graph, degree four and simplicity, finite-support operator inverse on all functions. Prior zigzag and permutational-power factorization methods credited.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the free-product Cayley construction, simple connected graph, finite inverse for UBU, and its application to all functions.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked reflection-palindrome correspondence, free-product deletion invariant, noncrossing recurrence and factor recovery. Prior Dyer deletion theorem credited; specialized proof is included directly.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the palindrome/reflection correspondence, noncrossing cancellation repair, dynamic program for the two words, and factor recovery.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the cofinite-isomorphism-type quantifier, both computable reductions and centralizer realization in every sufficiently large symmetric degree. Imported finite-group-theory undecidability explicitly separated.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the first-order star interpretation, common-centralizer construction in every sufficiently large symmetric group, both reductions, and the distinction between cofinite truth and density.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked primary input and output restrictions, hyperfocal generation, Frattini and radical reductions, and the dihedral contradiction. An odd primary component acting nontrivially suffices; no unsupported prime-order component choice is required.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the exact hyperfocal input, perfect minimal Frattini reduction without passing the hypothesis to quotients, and minimal-simple/Baer-Suzuki step.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked Lazard subgroup input, formal BCH closure under scalar extension, residual correction on the common flag, dimension-only inverse degree and weighted extraction in the original addition. Strong nilpotence is not assumed.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the class-less-than-p Lazard setting, common flag bound, polynomial BCH correction, and homogeneous averaging in the original coordinates.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the compact-family neighborhood argument, full Vietoris upper subbasis, height-four construction, selector obstruction and positive embedding. Prior neighborhood lemma and Dow-Watson space are credited.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the full Vietoris compact-family argument, the height-four Dow-Watson obstruction, and the sufficient embedding.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked centered enumeration, all half-coordinate signs, splitting compatibility and uniqueness, exact dual divisibility, and numerical-denominator complexity. The general coordinate criterion is distinguished from prior two-dimensional results.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread normalized duals and all splitting lines, exhaustive half-tie enumeration, and the prime-power rank bound. CGG Claims 3.1 and 3.2 reread with attribution.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked free-product tree action, tameness parameters, geometric primitivity of abc, admissible initial rescaling and prescribed odd relation in Amelio v2 construction. Checked finite-subgroup lifting to a stage, all-involution pair products and perfectness. Deep geometric existence is explicitly imported.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the imported Amelio v2 parameters, primitive triple choice, strict numerical inequality, finite-subgroup lifting limit, and perfectness from the odd relation.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked small-support and large-support odd-target factorizations, imported covering hypotheses and parity, modular root extraction, swapped exponent order, and strict explicit/asymptotic prime bounds.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread permutation-cover hypotheses, degree and support restriction, missing-prime interval estimate, and all c greater than eight.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked variable-exponent monodromy, normal convergence, first-zero existence, and all three meanings of the matrix condition. Reread FNP count polynomials and limiting formulas.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread all FNP product formulas and both separability conventions, normal convergence, alternating bounds near negative zeros, and the nonintegral-exponent monodromy obstruction.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the bounded-support marked-limit construction, residual finiteness of the finitary normal subgroup, independent kernels, and the two Conder cycle choices.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the imported Conder cycle constructions, fixed short-support word, finitary ultralimit orbits, finite-quotient obstruction, independent kernels, and continuum isomorphism count.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked all two-subgroups have order at most two without infinite Sylow assumptions, existence of odd-order radical by directed products, and perfect normal-generation obstruction to central involution image. Shares the 10.62 construction.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the shared 10.62 input, existence of the periodic odd radical, and the involution conjugacy/perfectness obstruction.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked ordinary one-sorted quasigroup signature, the factorial translation identity, finite coordinate-shift witnesses for all three generation notions, and the monogenic infinite example. Precise source conventions remain in final source audit.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the fixed finite identity and affine isotope obstruction for every selected prime. Corrected the supplementary infinite one-generator example to use that same prime; shift and addition construction checked again (E016).

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the PSL6(5^a) order valuation, characteristic-two heart irreducibility argument from Bray, and exponent toggling for each prescribed 2-part.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the imported heart irreducibility and given weight proof, 2-adic order valuation, and all Hensel-lifted degrees.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the unrestricted A-group axioms, commuting-pair cocycle identity, tensor-completion mapping, and persistent iterated commutators.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread unrestricted A-group axioms, square-zero scalar construction, homogeneity on commuting triples, and the fixed-pair nonterminating commutator sequence.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the finite multiplication-table criterion, polynomial interpolation quotient, direct-product injection, and nilpotence of the shift model.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the finite-difference functional, commuting shifted copies, nilpotent difference series, Jennings embedding, and local quasiidentity transfer.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the Magnus covering-graph kernel, affine associativity induction, category normalization, and full-variety scope; credited the prior verbal-operation method.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the associative-word and Laurent-unit argument, rank recognition and basis naturality. Full solvable-variety scope is distinguished from the prior proper-subvariety example.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked finite-subgroup cocycle averaging, torsion-free complement sections, the exact set-product intersection, and derived-length induction. The proof does not assert that every element of AB is periodic.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread finite averaging, the t-to-2t obstruction, torsion-free abelian kernel, and last-derived torsion quotient; no unsupported periodicity of AB is used.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the three power relations, exclusion of wreath quotients, filtered Golod-Shafarevich inequality, and the width-to-Hilbert-series contradiction.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the three-power wreath-quotient exclusion, filtered Golod-Shafarevich denominator, and lower-p-central normal-form/dimension contradiction.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked arbitrary faithful-action coprime product closure, finite-action reduction, J1 input, and the nontrivial Fitting subgroup.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread all faithful orbit decompositions in the coprime product, the finite-to-arbitrary action extension, and the cited J1 theorem with exact Fitting subgroup.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the rank-two reduction and square closedness bridge; replayed all 104 requests and integer G2 identities in the portable ancillary directory. Printed all 19 representatives. Explicitly credited prior 19.63 criterion.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread rank-two restriction and absolute constants, all-ring integer proof calculus, and direct closedness proof including bad characteristics and isogeny. Fresh 104-target and 120-identity checks passed. Added explicit prior simply-laced and good-characteristic coverage (E017).

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked both ordered substitutions and independent variables with equal root labels, the directed square completion, and the A-D-C sandwich. Portable replay verified 300 universal integer proofs and 12 corruptions.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread independent inputs in both ordered binomial rules, the 300 integer targets, directed finite adjoining, and the closed-carpet sandwich without asserting equality of completion and derived carpet.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the polynomial-ring net and rank-one alternating-degree obstruction, including the order of specialization and ring membership.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the alternating rank-one polynomial word, reduction to k[x] rather than its fraction field, and the exceptional cubic obstruction.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked strict subgroup chain, normality of [T,N], centralization of the proper-power normal generator, and the explicit semidirect quotient. No unstated torsion-free quotient condition is imposed.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread the proper-power normal closure modulo [T,N], central amalgam, generic properness, and absence of a maximality assumption.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked the affine triple-intersection table, Fitting subgroup, all minimum-order intersections, and the distinction from prior pair examples.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread all nine conjugate stabilizers, the 81 ordered pairs, ten intersections and five minimum-order intersections, and the generated subgroup outside the Fitting subgroup.

entries.first_pass_notes: Checked all Sylow-2 normalizers, the linear-equation intersection bound, the exact witness, Frattini subgroup, and trivial hypercentre.
entries.final_pass_notes: Reread all Sylow normalizers, the linear intersection bound and exact witness, trivial center and Frattini subgroup. The prior theorem assumes trivial Frattini subgroup and does not cover this family.
